description_en: Decodes the permission diagnostic information from the response body of a request that was denied due to insufficient RAM permissions
description_zh: 从因无RAM权限导致的请求被拒绝访问的响应体中解码无权限诊断信息
name: DecodeDiagnosticMessage

parameters.help_en: The encoded diagnostic information obtained from the `AccessDeniedDetail.EncodedDiagnosticMessage` field in the response body when an API request is denied due to insufficient permissions. This parameter is used to decode the permission diagnostic information and must be specified when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh: API请求因无权限被拒绝访问时，从响应体 `AccessDeniedDetail.EncodedDiagnosticMessage`字段中获取的编码诊断信息。该参数用于解码无权限诊断信息，调用本接口时需传入
parameters.name: encoded_diagnostic_message

AuthAction.description_en: The operation information used for authentication in the user request
AuthAction.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的操作信息

AuthConditions.description_en: The list of conditions used for authentication in the user request
AuthConditions.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的条件列表

ConditionKey.description_en: The key of the authentication condition

ConditionValues.description_en: The list of values that correspond to the authentication condition key
ConditionValues.description_zh: 鉴权条件Key对应的值列表

items.description_en: The condition value that corresponds to the authentication condition key
items.description_zh: 鉴权条件Key对应的条件值

AuthPrincipal.description_en: The principal information used for authentication in the user request
AuthPrincipal.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的主体信息

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en:
The identity identifier used for authentication in the user request. Valid values:

Resource Access Management (RAM) user: the UID of the RAM user.
RAM role: the role name and role session name (for example, RoleName:RoleSessionName).
SSO federated identity: the identity provider type and identity provider name (for example, saml-provider/AzureAD)
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh:
用户请求中用于鉴权的身份标识。具体如下：

RAM用户：提供的是RAM用户的UID信息。
RAM角色：提供的是角色名称和角色会话名称（例如：RoleName:RoleSessionName）。
SSO联合身份：提供的是身份提供商类型和身份提供商名称（例如：saml-provider/AzureAD）

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the identity used for authentication in the user request belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的身份所属的阿里云账号UID信息

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type used for authentication in the user request
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的身份类型

AuthResource.description_en: The resource information used for authentication in the user request
AuthResource.description_zh: 用户请求中用于鉴权的资源信息

ExplicitDeny.description_en: Indicates whether the denial is an explicit deny

MatchedPolicies.description_en: The list of policies matched during authentication

AttachedEntityType.description_en: The type of the entity to which the policy is attached

AttachedScope.description_en: The authorization scope of the policy

PolicyIdentifier.description_en:
The policy name information. Valid values:
Control policy: the ID of the control policy.
RAM permission policy: the name of the access policy
PolicyIdentifier.description_zh:
策略名称信息。具体如下：
管控策略：管控策略ID。
RAM权限策略：权限策略名称

PolicyVersion.description_en:
The version number of the policy.
Only custom policies have version numbers
PolicyVersion.description_zh:
策略版本号。
仅自定义策略有版本号

NoPermissionPolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the permission denial
NoPermissionPolicyType.description_zh: 产生无权限的策略类型

enumValueTitles.ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: 基于身份策略（资源组级）
